title: JANUS A17.8 HRain + Buzz Swarm Orchestration and Resilience Layer

summary.short: A local observer-only swarm visibility and resilience stack connecting Buzz ESP32 roster telemetry to NAS, A18 bridge, and HRain UI.
summary.long: This registry entry captures the current stage of the JANUS A17.8 HRain live swarm overlay project. The project connects an ESP32/M5 swarm master named Buzz to a local Python roster sidecar, forwards sanitized roster presence into NAS Brain, bridges the data into A18, and renders the state inside HRain. The current PC-side one-click launch path is assembled and validated; the remaining active issue is device-side Buzz full-roster posting reliability after firmware changes.

claim_limits: This is a local experimental telemetry and visualization stack.
This entry does not claim financial advantage, mining profitability, or protocol superiority.
Accepted-share telemetry is treated as run-local signal only, not a general proof.
No offensive, targeting, intrusion, or exploitation capability is described or claimed.

current_stage.stage_name: A17.8 one-click PC orchestration with Buzz roster sidecar guard
current_stage.summary: PC-side startup path is now coherent: RUN_ALL_A17 starts/verifies sidecar, miner, HRain shell, and embedded A18 bridge. Buzz roster tick still needs firmware-side diagnostics because the sidecar can start cleanly while post_count_total remains zero.
current_stage.overall_verdict: PC orchestration PASS; Buzz roster firmware tick pending

intended_flow: Buzz ESP32 swarm master collects local swarm visibility.
Buzz posts full roster to local buzz_roster_sidecar on port 8011.
Sidecar validates observer-only state and forwards sanitized samples to NAS Brain on port 8008.
A18 NAS Swarm Bridge reads NAS swarm state and sidecar freshness.
HRain serves visual UI on port 8797.
A17/A14.2 miner runs independently; protocol semantics remain frozen.

ports_publicly_documented_as_roles_only.8011: Buzz roster sidecar local/LAN health and roster ingest
ports_publicly_documented_as_roles_only.8797: HRain local UI and A18 overlay

changes: Removed -NoExit from first orchestrator tab so it does not remain hanging after start.
Starts Buzz roster sidecar as a Windows Terminal tab instead of a separate CMD window.
Checks sidecar by real health JSON, not merely occupied port.
validation: One-click launch from A17.8 pack executed

changes: Health exposes nas_base_url_configured boolean without leaking NAS host.
Previously added last-roster telemetry and last-good cache remain part of resilience design.

constraints: NAS was not restarted during current launch fix.

A18_NAS_Swarm_Bridge.current_reported_issue: buzz_roster_state=missing when Buzz full roster is not posted after launch

known_regression: After roster-sidecar firmware patch, previous hashrate-zero self-recovery behavior appears to have regressed.
Buzz may show hashrate 0 and not recover automatically.
Buzz full roster POST tick may not run after clean PC launch even though sidecar is healthy.
next_patch_scope: Add diagnostics explaining why buzzRosterPostTick is skipped.
Keep roster POST best-effort and non-blocking.
Restore hashrate-zero deadman guard without changing WIRE/HASH/SUBMIT semantics.

Gladius_and_RFAnchorAux.observed_problem: Buzz sometimes sees 8/10 participants overnight; after rebooting two nodes, visibility returns to 10/10.
planned_patch: ESP-NOW soft reinit and presence burst.
Delayed hard restart fallback only after long repeated failure.

remaining_gap.interpretation: PC orchestration is healthy; remaining problem is Buzz firmware roster tick or Buzz-side posting condition.

forbidden_in_this_stage: Do not touch PEA4/COM19 or BlindEYE/COM4 during Buzz-only firmware work.
Do not modify NAS core during sidecar/UI work.
Do not expose secrets or LAN host details in public registry entries.

resilience_features_completed.details: Launcher checks sidecar health and starts it if missing, while avoiding duplicate sidecar instances.
Health exposes safety state and nas_base_url_configured without leaking internal host.
A18 can distinguish fresh/grace/stale/missing roster state.
UI can show waiting/stale status instead of collapsing ambiguously.
Old test probe nodes are filtered from A18 visible nodes.
